title: Sinusoidal Measurement (PLL, Three-Phase)
text: 使用锁相环估计三相正弦特征，输入 1 路、输出 3 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Enable moving average filter on input} 启用频率相关移动平均滤波器、{Enable input normalization} 启用输入归一化、{Loop filter proportional gain} 指定 LF 比例增益、{Loop filter integral gain} 指定 LF 积分增益、{Initial frequency (Hz)} 指定输入频率的初始估计值、{Initial phase angle (rad)} 指定相位角的初始估计值，按实例取值。

params.name: Enable moving average filter on input
params.values: 启用频率相关移动平均滤波器的选项 On (default) | Off

params.name: Enable input normalization
params.values: 启用输入归一化的选项 Off (default) | On

params.name: Loop filter proportional gain
params.values: LF 比例增益 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Loop filter integral gain
params.values: LF 积分增益 10 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Initial frequency (Hz)
params.values: 输入频率的初始估计值 60 Hz (default) | scalar

params.name: Initial phase angle (rad)
params.values: 相位角的初始估计值 0 rad (default) | scalar or vector

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive scalar
